)

cards.sql:
SELECT 
    u."updatedAt",
    u.name,    
    TO_CHAR(
        u."updatedAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago',
        'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "Last Login",
    u.email,
    TO_CHAR(
        u."createdAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago',
        'MM/DD/YY HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS "First Login"
FROM 
    "User" AS u
{{ filters | where }}
    AND 1 = 1 
    AND u.name NOT IN (
        'Rohit Pujari',
        'testing-demo-dashboard-delete zzz',
        'Sam Dannovan'
    )
ORDER BY 
    u."updatedAt" DESC
cards.title: Users

cards.sql:
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', d."createdAt"), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
    u.name AS user_name,
    COUNT(d.id) AS dashboard_count
FROM 
    "Dashboard" AS d
JOIN 
    "Project" AS p ON d."projectId" = p.id
JOIN 
    "User" AS u ON p."userId" = u.id
 {{ filters | where }} GROUP BY 
    month, u.name
ORDER BY 
    month asc
cards.title: Dashboards by Project User

cards.description: Monthly active users based on their last login date.
cards.sql:
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR("updatedAt", 'YYYY-MM') AS mm_yyyy,
    COUNT(id) AS user_count
FROM "User" as u
 {{ filters | where }} AND 
    name != 'Rohit Pujari'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "updatedAt") >= 2024
GROUP BY 
    mm_yyyy
ORDER BY 
    mm_yyyy Asc
LIMIT 100;
cards.title: Monthly Active Users

LEFT JOIN "User" u ON p."userId" = u.id where u.name != 'Rohit Pujari'
